### The Sin Offering
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sin-offering
Passage: Leviticus 4:35
Points:
- Sin generates real moral pollution that defiles the worshiper and God's dwelling place.
- The sin offering functioned essentially as a purification offering, cleansing the sanctuary and removing contamination.
- While the burnt offering propitiated divine wrath, the sin offering expiated the defilement caused by covenant violations.
- The rite provided atonement for unintentional offenses and failures of omission, contrasting with unrepentant, defiant rebellion.
- Through Christ, believers receive total cleansing and forgiveness when they turn to God in contrite repentance.

### Bible Pathways - Feb. 2, 2008
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-feb-2-2008-11566585.html
Passage: Leviticus 4:2
Points:
- The sin offering required the offender to lay hands on the victim to signify the transfer of guilt.
- In this offering, the Israelite approached the Lord not primarily as a worshiper, but as a convicted sinner.
- Sins committed by priests and leaders carried heightened weight, necessitating sacrifices equal to that of the entire assembly.
- Disposing of the bull's remains outside the camp kept the camp clean and foreshadowed Christ suffering outside the gate.
- Animal sacrifices were provisional pointers to Jesus, whose final atonement calls believers to live consecrated lives.
